related_ecosystem.name: Zernio (ZernFlow and API family)

related_ecosystem.note: Not presented as a Tayoca product; branding relationship unconfirmed.

related_ecosystem.name: 9Drive
related_ecosystem.summary: Storage gateway web app connecting multiple Google Drive accounts into one virtual dashboard, with S3-compatible endpoints and upload routing (live preview 9drive.zenhosta.com). Source repo under zenhosta; mirrored as a fork on the founder's account.
related_ecosystem.note: Relationship to Tayoca unconfirmed; not published.

related_ecosystem.name: zenhosta storefront products

related_ecosystem.note: Relationship to Tayoca unconfirmed; not published.
